steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Textile traditions carry deep cultural meaning — African wax prints, Indian block printing, Japanese shibori, Scandinavian knitting each tell stories of place and identity. | Key Fact: Contemporary textile designers draw on tradition while innovating — understanding history enriches your own creative decisions. | Key Fact: Sustainability and ethics in textiles: consider material sourcing, dye pollution, fast fashion, fair trade and waste reduction. | Key Fact: Your research should INSPIRE your own work — adapt traditional techniques for contemporary purposes, do not just reproduce them.
